Package org.geysermc.paletter.item.component

Record Class KineticWeapon

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
org.geysermc.paletter.item.component.KineticWeapon
Record Components:
creativeReach - Defines the reach used when the user is in Creative Mode. Defaults to "reach" if unspecified. Add-on JSON creative_reach. Optional (null: not set).
damageConditions - Conditions that need to be satisfied for damage to be applied. If not specified, damage is not applied. Add-on JSON damage_conditions. Optional (null: not set).
damageModifier - Value added to the the scaled dot product (after applying "damage_multiplier"). Add-on JSON damage_modifier. Default: 0.
damageMultiplier - Value multiplied to sum of the dot products of the user and target's velocity vectors projected onto the view vector. Add-on JSON damage_multiplier. Default: 1.
delay - Time, in ticks, after which kinetic damage and its effects start being applied. Add-on JSON delay. Default: 0.
dismountConditions - Conditions that need to be satisfied for riders to be dismounted. If not specified, riders cannot be dismounted. Add-on JSON dismount_conditions. Optional (null: not set).
hitboxMargin - Added tolerance to the view vector raycast for detecting entity collisions. Add-on JSON hitbox_margin. Default: 0.
knockbackConditions - Conditions that need to be satisfied for knockback to be applied. If not specified, knockback is not applied. Add-on JSON knockback_conditions. Optional (null: not set).
reach - Defines the range (in blocks) along the user's view vector where entities can be hit. Defines the range (in blocks) along the user's view vector where entities can be hit. Only targets within this distance are considered. Block collisions between the user and target block damage and its effects. Add-on JSON reach. Default: {"max":3,"min":0}.
All Implemented Interfaces:
ItemComponent
@BedrockFormat("1.21.130") public record KineticWeapon(@Nullable KineticWeapon.CreativeReach creativeReach, @Nullable KineticWeapon.Conditions damageConditions, float damageModifier, float damageMultiplier, int delay, @Nullable KineticWeapon.Conditions dismountConditions, float hitboxMargin, @Nullable KineticWeapon.Conditions knockbackConditions, @NonNull KineticWeapon.Reach reach) extends Record implements ItemComponent
Allows an item to deal kinetic damage and its effects. This happens every tick while in use, in a straight line along the user's view vector, with damage computed based on both the user's and the target's velocity projected onto the view vector (via a dot product). The more the user and target move toward each other, and the more this movement is aligned with the user's view vector, the higher the damage. After "damage_multiplier" and "damage_modifier" are applied, the resulting damage is floored to the nearest lower integer.

Add-on JSON: "minecraft:kinetic_weapon".

Since:
1.0.0
